messages:
maya_marketing: hey @owen_runtime @samir_eng — marketing needs a tiny, reproducible bench pack + 2-sentence method note to support a launch claim: "~2x per-token cost reduction with 4-bit quant + adaptive batching". Publish goal: Friday AM. can runtime run a fast, defensible smoke?

owen_runtime: yes. propose cohorts tiny (<=30), standard (~120), long (~400). compare fp16 baseline vs 4-bit quant. hardware = staging A100. what conservatism level for wording?

maya_marketing: conservative please — we'll use language like "about" or "roughly" if numbers are noisy. legal wants caveats.

osamir_eng: warmup plan: 40 tiny, 15 standard, then measured runs. config: repeats=4, conc levels 1,5,10. export per-request CSV + sample traces (5/cohort). seed=777 for reproducibility.

owen_runtime: metrics we'll produce: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, coldstart first-token latency, and per-token cost normalized to the fp16 baseline. quantify cost = prorated GPU time + infra overhead; we'll add the exact formula in the method note.

bench-bot: queued run: https://ci.internal/run/1798887776-smoke. started 1798887810. ETA ~50m.

maya_marketing: include a short plain-language blurb we can paste (1-2 paragraphs) and a 1-line safe harbor for legal. also need S3 links to artifacts.

owen_runtime: will do. note: initial 4-bit runs use default kernels (label them "initial-quant"). if we have time we'll run a quick kernel tuning pass (+~2h) and post updated artifacts with a "quant_tuned" suffix.

osamir_eng: sample payloads for standard cohort: {"input":"Write two short sentences describing Redwood Inference for a product blog.","max_tokens":90,"temperature":0.0,"seed":777} — use same RNG across runs.

bench-bot: run completed. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1798887776/initial_smoke.tar.gz (csvs + traces + logs).

owen_runtime: preliminary fp16 tuned runs uploaded. quant4 initial runs available at s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1798887776/quant4_initial/. will post tuned quant artifacts if tuning finishes today.

maya_marketing: marketing will note quant as "initial" unless you confirm tuned artifacts by Thu EOD. legal-bot please advise language.

legal-bot: suggested safe harbor: "Benchmarks reflect internal tests on specific hardware and workloads; results may vary in other environments. Numbers labeled 'initial' may improve after tuning."

owen_runtime: posting a 3-bullet method note now: 1) cohorts and counts, 2) warmup and repeats, 3) cost calc formula + hardware. also uploading reproduce script to the S3 folder.

maya_marketing: awesome — once tuned artifacts (if any) are posted i'll draft the blog line and circulate to legal. thanks team! :pray:
